reviews.title: The screen is awesome, comes with a separate piece of software to use it.
reviews.comment: This AIO is very well priced. In terms of performance, I have it cooling a 12600K, and it stays at around 30 degrees under load. Great performance. It runs quieter than my other son's Thermalright peerless assassin build which is air cooled while keeping it cooler. The assembly is simple. The holes for the backplate are already in the motherboard, just slide it through from the back and push firmly. There is tape on the backplate to keep it sturdy and attached to the motherboard. The single greatest aspect of this very moderately priced AIO is the really cool screen that displays some system info and a really cool if purely aesthetic mini monitor. This goes perfectly in a white build, especially one RGB focused.

reviews.title: Great Performance & Looks — Excellent Value AIO!
reviews.comment:
The Thermalright FW360 White ARGB is one of the best value AIOs I’ve used. It keeps my CPU cool under load, runs quietly, and the 360mm radiator with three PWM fans delivers excellent thermal performance.
The standout feature is the detachable IPS LCD screen — crisp, customizable, and a nice bonus at this price. The white design with ARGB lighting looks fantastic in a clean build and syncs easily with motherboard headers.
Installation was smooth, it supports both Intel and AMD sockets, and everything fit well out of the box. For under $100, this cooler offers premium features you’d normally find in much more expensive models.
Highly recommended for builders looking for performance, aesthetics, and great value!
reviews.author: Crush

reviews.title: Blows exepectations for price.
reviews.comment: Recived today. Just had installed. First of all, quality is immaculate. Both the box and the product feel of quality. The fans are nice and quiet, keeping my cpu nice and cool (never peaked 82C under heavy gaming on my r7 7700x). However, there are some areas of complaint. The included thermal paste was dried, and my cpu was throttling because there was a dried lump of thermal paste. The screen is extremely buggy, uploading my own image is a gamble between working and completely pooping itslef. Software is very buggy, with instructions unclear. The bracket, in my all white build, is a eyesore. However, the price covers heavilly for the areas of complaint. Overall, a good all in one cooling solution for your cpu.
